subject: Conditional discount acceleration and consolidated invoice agreement
messages:
From: ClearScale Procurement <procurement@clearscale.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: finance@clearscale.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood billing & PO requirements / proposed net60

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. Quick procurement note ahead of our SOW signing — finance has two asks we need agreed for PO onboarding: 1) ClearScale requires consolidated monthly invoices where the PO number is present on every line and the invoice includes our GL mapping (we'll supply the mapping file). 2) Standard net60 payment terms from our side.

Also, the business is looking for a conditional discount acceleration tied to quarterly consumption: if we hit the attached quarterly threshold, a retroactive 4% volume rebate should apply to that quarter. Can Redwood support a rebate/acceleration mechanism and accept split invoices (weekly billing segments) during ramp?

I've attached our PO template and a short procurement checklist. Please confirm whether Redwood can comply with: PO number on each line, monthly consolidated invoice (preferred), net60, and the conditional volume rebate. If you have alternatives (early-pay discounts, consolidated statements + weekly invoice stubs), let us know.

Thanks — we need a quick yes/no so legal can finish the DocuSign.

Regards,
Mike Adams
Procurement Lead, ClearScale
procurement@clearscale.com

Attachment: clearscale_po_template.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: ClearScale Procurement <procurement@clearscale.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood billing & PO requirements / proposed net60

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can accommodate most of this but need to outline options so finance/legal are aligned. Summary below (short bullets) and then a proposal for how we can meet ClearScale’s objectives while keeping revenue operations clean.

- PO on each line: we can require the PO number to be present on every invoice line item. We will need the GL mapping file to validate automatically.
- Consolidated monthly invoice: primary option. We can produce a single monthly invoice with line-level PO references and an attached weekly summary (stubs) during ramp.
- Split/weekly stubs: we can support weekly invoice stubs for early visibility but will submit one consolidated invoice for payment.
- Net terms: our standard is Net30. We can offer Net60 only under one of two conditions: (A) a minimum committed monthly spend of $50k OR (B) a pre-authorized credit holdback (e.g., 15% reserve) during the first 90 days.
- Conditional volume rebate: we can implement a retroactive quarterly rebate but need the threshold and calculation spelled out in the SOW. We prefer a capped rebate (no clawback beyond actual overage) and a maximum rebate % per quarter.

Proposal (what we can sign to get DocuSign moving):
1) Redwood to accept consolidated monthly invoice (with weekly stubs attached for ramp visibility).
2) Redwood accepts Net60 for the first 3 months provided ClearScale commits to a minimum monthly spend of $50,000 OR provides a 15% onboarding reserve to be released after 90 days.
3) Volume rebate: 4% retroactive rebate if quarterly consumption > $200,000, capped at 4% for that quarter. Rebate will appear as a credit on the subsequent invoice.
4) We will accept PO numbering on each line and implement automated GL mapping validation (we'll test once we have mapping).

I'll loop in Finance (Naomi) and Vivek for a quick sign-off on the Net60 path — Naomi, quick read and confirmation below? Vivek — please confirm commercial acceptance or whether we should offer a smaller onboarding credit instead.

Attached: sample_redwood_invoice.pdf (pdf) and a proposed_discount_schedule.xlsx (stub).

If that works for ClearScale, we can put this language into the Master Billing Addendum and then legal can finish DocuSign.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Tessa.Morgan@redwood.com

Attachments: sample_redwood_invoice.pdf, proposed_discount_schedule.xlsx
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ClearScale billing & PO requirements / proposed net60 — quick ops check

Naomi / Vivek — forwarding Mike's ask and my reply above. Need finance guidance before I lock this with procurement:

- Option A (preferred by sales): offer Net60 with a $50k/month minimum commit for 90 days + onboarding credit $10k on first invoice.
- Option B: accept Net60 with 15% reserve for 90 days (released pro rata after 90 days) — less commercial concession up front but operationally heavier.
- Rebate: allow 4% retro rebate if quarterly $200k threshold met, capped at 4%. Is there any revenue recognition exposure or clawback risk we need to flag?

Notes for Finance: if we go with Option A, we should tag the deal with a revenue hold flag and require AR to validate PO match before release. Also recommend we create an automation rule that rejects invoices missing PO per-line.

Can you reply with either Approve-Option-A, Approve-Option-B, or Suggested-Alternative? I need to reply to procurement today.

Thanks — Tessa
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 20:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearScale billing & PO requirements / proposed net60 — quick ops check

Tessa — quick guidance from Finance: Approve-Option-A with guardrails.

- Approve Net60 if ClearScale signs a minimum monthly commitment of $50k for the first 90 days. We need that in writing in the billing addendum.
- Approve $10k one-time onboarding credit on first invoice; that credit should be amortized for revenue recognition purposes over the first billing month.
- Rebate is acceptable with the following: rebate calculation must be automated and appear as a credit on the invoice following the quarter. No retrospective cash refunds (credit only). Cap rebate at 4% per quarter and include a clause that prevents a retroactive clawback beyond the credited amount.
- Operational asks: require PO per-line (we will implement a matching rule in AR), provide GL mapping file, and send an initial test invoice to naomi.feldman@redwood.com for validation prior to first billing run.

I will authorize AR to set up the PO validation and to enable the revenue hold flag until we receive the signed addendum. If procurement wants Net60 without the commit, we should not accept it.

—Naomi
Finance Director, Revenue Operations
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: ClearScale Procurement <procurement@clearscale.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood billing & PO requirements / proposed net60 — confirmation

Mike — thanks for the patience. We have internal approval with these final terms (please confirm):

1) Billing cadence: Redwood will issue a consolidated monthly invoice with weekly stub attachments for ramp visibility. The consolidated invoice will be used for payment.
2) PO requirements: PO number must appear on each invoice line. ClearScale to supply GL mapping file prior to first invoice. Redwood will run an automated PO/line validation during billing submission.
3) Net terms: Net60 granted for first 90 days provided ClearScale commits to a minimum spend of $50,000/month for that period. Commitment must be included in the Master Billing Addendum (DocuSign).
4) Onboarding credit: Redwood will apply a one-time $10,000 credit on the first invoice; credit amortized per finance guidance.
5) Volume rebate: Retroactive quarterly credit of 4% if quarterly consumption > $200,000. Rebate will be issued as an invoice credit on the subsequent invoice and capped at 4% (no cash refunds).

If these points match ClearScale’s expectation, please attach the signed PO and the GL mapping CSV and we’ll have legal add the commit language to the billing addendum and push DocuSign.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Tessa.Morgan@redwood.com

Attachments: sample_redwood_invoice.pdf, proposed_discount_schedule.xlsx
